newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australia lower house confirms labour bill.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australia lower house confirms labour bill.

text.p: The Australian House of Representatives on Thursday formally confirmed the Senate's amendments to its labour reform bill.
Passage of the amended bill through the government controlled lower house, required for it to become law, was expected, since the government voted for the amendments in the Senate.

Industrial Relations Minister Peter Reith has promised more jobs and faster economic growth as a result of reforms, which will deregulate Australia's labour market, emphasising a freer market and reducing the role of unions.
